notes.title: Celebrate the Tristia:restore Korean Language Update with a 50% Off Sale!
notes.content:
[p]We're thrilled to announce that Tristia:restore now supports the Korean language! [/p][p]To celebrate the Korean language update, we're offering Tristia:restore at 50% off for one week only! Don't miss this chance to experience the game at a discounted price. Sale ends June 16th![/p][p]This update brings the enchanting world of Tristia closer to our Korean-speaking players, allowing more fans to play as Nanoca Flanka in the crafting minigame spinoff of Tristia:legacy in their native language.[/p][p]Want to see Nanoca's original adventure? Tristia:legacy is also getting a Korean language update! Explore the original story and experience of Nanoca’s adventure, also 50% off for the duration of the sale![/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: 「Version 1.0.4」Update
notes.content:
[p]Dear Tristia fans,

We have released "Version 1.0.4" which solves the problem of not being able to clear the "Character Approval" in the various mini-games. For those of you who were unable to proceed with the game due to this problem, we would appreciate it if you could check again after the update.

The updated details are as follows.

[/p][h3]Bug fixes[/h3][list][*][p] Fixed a bug that prevented the character approval in the Solar Reactor mini-game from being cleared (except for the Japanese version).
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed a bug that prevented the character approval of the Stuka mini-game from being cleared (except for the Japanese version).
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed a bug that prevented the character approval of the Tenzan mini-game from being cleared (except for the Japanese version).
[/p][/*][*][p] Adjustments to some scenarios
[/p][/*][*][p] Other minor adjustments
  (Correction of wording in HELP, correction of text displayed in mini-game results)
[/p][/*][/list][p] Thank you for your support and please let us know if there are any other issues.  Regards,[/p]

notes.title: 「Version 1.0.3」Update
notes.content:
Dear Tristia fans,

We apologize for the inconvenience caused to our fans by several glitches in the recently released "Tristia:restore". Today, we have released Version 1.0.3, which resolves the currently known issues.

The updated details are as follows.

[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduced load times
[*] Fixed bug where player could clip through objects.
[*] Fixed bug where items would get stuck in objects and can not be removed.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Stuka mini-game would become impossible to progress.
[*] Fixed an issue where items could not be removed from the mixing desk.
[*] Fixed an issue where the barques would remain on the delivery screen.
[*] Fixed an issue where items could not be picked up after using a cutter.
[*] Correction of some wording.
[*] Modification of some recipes.
[*] Other minor fixes.
[/list]

Thank you for your support and please let us know if there are any other issues.

Regards,
